data.description:
## Context

Test isolation under ~90-worktree/xdist parallelism is 15.8% of the defect stream (R2S1), and the harness root already exists and propagates (tests/conftest.py:487-513 `_rebar_root_sandbox_repo` + autouse REBAR_ROOT setenv, per-worker under xdist via tmp_path_factory — 12a Part 1). What is missing is ENFORCEMENT: nothing stops a new unit-tier test from spawning a subprocess with its own ad-hoc temp/HOME/root, which is exactly how the recent class instances arose (82a0d5cd: doctor scan resolving the operator's real Path.home(); ef9e1d74: subprocess timing conflation). Precedent: pip's pytest_collection_modifyitems raising on forbidden patterns; Bazel's hermetic TEST_TMPDIR contract (12c) recorded as the escalation path.

## Approach

A collection-time check in the unit-tier conftest: tests whose module spawns subprocesses (detected statically: subprocess/Popen/pytest.main markers, or an explicit marker) must either use the harness-provided root fixtures/env or carry an explicit opt-out marker with a reason. Violations fail collection with a message naming the fixture to use (fail-loud, names-the-fix pattern already used by the network guard). Bound the static detection conservatively (no false positives on the 564 existing subprocess-spawning files: run the check across the tier and baseline any legitimate existing patterns rather than mass-editing).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: collection fails with an instructive error when a unit-tier test spawns a subprocess without taking its root from the harness (test proves it fires on a seeded violation).
- [ ] AC2: the full unit tier collects clean at introduction (existing legitimate patterns baselined or fixed, no blanket opt-outs).
- [ ] AC3: the opt-out marker requires a reason string and is counted (greppable) so growth is visible to the mechanism ratchet.
- [ ] AC4: the check and marker documented alongside the existing isolation helpers.

## File impact

- tests/unit/conftest.py or tests/conftest.py (collection hook)
- tests/_isolation.py or a new tests/_collection_guards.py helper (detection logic)
- tests/unit/test_collection_isolation_guard.py (new; RED/GREEN proof)
- docs (the testing/isolation section that documents existing guards)
data.title: Collection-time enforcement: unit-tier subprocess tests must take isolation roots from the harness
